name: dev-flow-orchestrator
description: A clear, resumable V4 development workflow for Codex on macOS.

interface.shortDescription: Run clear single- or multi-repository V4 workflows
interface.longDescription: Runs one greenfield V4 controller on macOS. full@4 and lite@4 both support single- and multi-repository work, use explicit workspace selection, keep state outside repositories, and share one bounded repository orchestration kernel.
